en.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
en.description:
The cost of connecting two points is their Manhattan distance. Find the minimum total edge weight that connects all points so that there is exactly one simple path between any two points.

The standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges on this site are as defined in this problem statement.
en.input: n (1≤n≤1000), followed by n lines of integer coordinates x y (−10^6≤x,y≤10^6); all coordinates are distinct.
en.output: Output the total weight of the minimum spanning tree.
en.explanation: Run dense Prim on the complete graph: each time, add the unvisited point closest to the current tree and update the minimum Manhattan distances of the other points.
